topic: Stock Purchases and Sales: Long and Short
subtopic: Stock Purchases and Sales: Long and Short
source_evidence: A "short" position is generally the sale of a stock you do not own.
question: Misconception: A short position means you own the stock and expect to profit if its price rises.
answer: A short position generally involves selling stock you do not own. Short sellers typically expect the price to fall so they can buy the stock back at a lower price; if the price rises before they buy it back, they incur a loss.
